en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the dining hall.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Let's go in the freezer
Let's have some tea
Let's try fasting
Did you know...

In astronaut training, you have to be able
to survive in subzero temperatures!

If it's a competition to see who can
hold out the longest, I won't lose!

The loser has to say how many 
girls he's had a crush on!

Yeah, let's grab some tea and 
have a heart-to-heart.
Don't you keep any secrets from me!

Sidekicks and heroes shouldn't
have secrets between them, y'know?

What!? If you do that, you'll 
die for sure!

Do you have a fever? Don't push 
yourself, alright?

If you're not feeling well, it's because
of my poor management.

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Kaito looks deep in thought...
(Damn it...)
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Kaito's inner thoughts...?
